title: Girl Demands To Be Arrested After Her Best Friend Gets an OWI
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On June 4, 2022, an officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle after seeing it drive recklessly in Wyandotte, MI. It was soon determined the driver was operating while intoxicated. When she was taken into custody, the passenger exited the vehicle and demanded several times to be taken to jail with her. Police gave her multiple opportunities to leave but she refused. She eventually became very agitated and ended up having her wishes granted. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
